query:
SELECT cc.nome, cc.classificacao, 
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(15,2))) FROM lancamento_custo lc WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001 AND lc.contaCustoId = cc.id), 0) as total_abril
FROM conta_custo cc
ORDER BY total_abril DESC;
